# Trading Comps Builder

⚠️ **Finance warning / Avertissement finance** : informational only, not investment advice. A comps range frames what the market pays for similar businesses, it does not certify what one business is worth: peers can be mispriced together, multiples move, there is a real risk of loss in any investment priced off them, and no range here is a promise of return. Curated by Skill Harbor: the trading comps builder skill at the root of andreworia/claude-finance-skills. Use it when building the comps page of a valuation deck, framing a minority valuation reference, or pressure testing a public market reference range. The governing principle sets the tone: a peer is a company whose multiple a sophisticated investor would actually use to price the target, and everything else is a distractor, so the discipline sits in what gets cut, since a page with 25 names usually hides 6 peers behind 19 distractors. A candidate belongs only if it passes three tests: business model match on revenue model, customer profile and unit economics; financial profile match on growth, margins and capital intensity, or differences priced explicitly into the discussion; and enough trading liquidity and disclosure to produce a defensible multiple. Geography is a tag, not a filter, with any geographic multiple delta acknowledged. The workflow builds a long list of 25 to 50 names from competitor disclosure, analyst peer sets, proxy peer groups, sector indices and precedent deal sets before any cutting, scores...
